CustomField.description: Comma-delimited list of Profile Ids, wrapped in leading/trailing commas (",id1,id2,") for safe LIKE '%,id,%' matching (not a Lookup — Salesforce Metadata API does not support custom Lookup fields to the Profile object, and a single Lookup couldn't hold more than one Id regardless), set when Audience_Type__c = 'Profile'.
CustomField.label: Target Profile Ids
